data.one_liner: A 3D coverflow-style carousel widget for Flutter with perspective effects and controllers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable 3D coverflow carousel widget supporting horizontal and vertical layouts, smooth animations, perspective effects, entrance animations, and programmatic controller navigation.
use_when: You need a 3D coverflow or image carousel UI widget in your Flutter application.
You require custom spacing, perspective tilt, and center card overlays.
avoid_when: You need a standard flat linear list or standard list view without 3D effects.
strengths: Highly customizable 3D perspective and skew angles.
Built-in support for controllers, streams, and notifiers.
Includes features like autoplay, entrance animations, and hover tilt.
weaknesses: Limited to carousel and coverflow UI implementations.
